name: streamweaver-backend
description: StreamWeaver backend: streaming multipart uploads, transform streams, and MongoDB bulk ingestion

scripts.audit:memory: node scripts/generateCsv.js --rows 100000 --out tmp/audit-large.csv && node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=96 --max-semi-space-size=4 scripts/memoryAudit.js --file tmp/audit-large.csv --gc
scripts.audit:memory:live: node scripts/generateCsv.js --rows 10000000 --out tmp/audit-live.csv && node --expose-gc --max-old-space-size=96 --max-semi-space-size=4 scripts/memoryAudit.js --file tmp/audit-live.csv --gc
